steps.text: Round the number to the place the game asks for, then pick its nearest neighbour.
Tap the option that shows the correct rounded value.
To round, look at the digit just after the rounding place: 5 or more rounds up, less rounds down.

coach.mission: Round to the asked place and pick the neighbour.
whenStuck: Pick the rounded value, then tap “Check”.
Look at the digit just after the rounding place.
whenWrong: Rounding rule: the digit right after the place decides — 5 or more rounds up, less rounds down, then zero out the rest.
Check you rounded to the place the game asked for.
whenCorrect: You've got the rounding rule down.
coach.done: You can round to any place now. Keep going, or move on.

steps.text: Look at the digit just AFTER the rounding place: 5 or more rounds up, less rounds down. Tap the correctly rounded option.

onCorrect: Rounded right — you read the deciding digit correctly.
Yes! Everything after the rounding place becomes zero.
onWrong: Check the digit right after the rounding place: 5+ rounds up, less rounds down — then zero the rest.
Make sure you rounded to the place the game asked for.
practice.done: You can round to any place quickly and confidently!
